description: This file contains utility functions for filesystem operations such as deleting, copying, moving files and directories, reading and writing file contents, and creating directories and marker files. It is part of a larger project related to file system utilities in C.

methods.name: deleteDirHandler
methods.description: Deletes a directory, file, or symlink based on the type, used as a callback for directory listing.

methods.name: copyDirHandler
methods.description: Copies a directory, file, or symlink from source to destination, used as a callback for directory copying.

methods.name: mkdir_p
methods.description: Creates a directory and all necessary parent directories with specified permissions.

methods.name: readFileContents
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into memory, caller must free the returned buffer.

methods.name: readFileContentsWithTrim
methods.description: Reads file contents and trims trailing newline character.

methods.name: writeContentsToFileName
methods.description: Writes string contents to a file, using a temporary file and moving it atomically.

methods.name: copyFile
methods.description: Copies data between two open FILE streams.

methods.name: copyFileByPath
methods.description: Copies a file from source path to destination path.

methods.name: moveFile
methods.description: Moves a file from source to destination, handling cross-filesystem moves.

methods.name: doesNonEmptyFileExist
methods.description: Checks if a non-empty file exists.

methods.name: listDirectory
methods.description: Lists directory contents and applies a handler to each entry.

methods.name: deleteDirectory
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory and its contents.

methods.name: copyDirectory
methods.description: Copies a directory and its contents to a new location.

methods.name: createMarkerFile
methods.description: Creates a zero-length marker file at specified path.
